summary: Iteration 8 P0 visual+UX upgrade verification (frontend only). Verified marketing nav glass, Dashboard empty state with 3 starter chips + ASCII frame, sticky glass AppHeader, step-pipeline with active pulsing dot + connectors, Step 1 OutputCard contextual actions (Copy + Regenerate testids), Copy → clipboard write (1328 chars, multi-line) + 'Copied' state swap, mobile always-visible output-actions (opacity=1), no console/page errors when navigating step-nav-1..5 (including Step 4/5 which intentionally don't pass new OutputCard props), and login/admin routes load without 500.

minor.issue: Review request claimed body shape is { situation_input: { what, who, unclear } } but server's SituationIn model expects FLAT { what, who, unclear }. Frontend posts the flat shape correctly so this is just a documentation drift in the review prompt — not a code bug.

critical_code_review_comments: ProjectFlow.jsx is now 1501 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting Step1/Step2/Step3/Step4/Step5/OutputCard/AISuggestions into separate files for maintainability before adding more steps.

module-level _suggestCache in ProjectFlow.jsx is shared across all sessions/users in the same browser tab. Not a security risk (suggestions are not sensitive), but if a future tenant switches users without full reload, prior suggestions could surface. Consider keying cache by user.id or clearing on logout.
Dashboard starter-chip handler calls document.querySelector inside setTimeout(0) — works, but a ref-based focus() would be more idiomatic React and resilient if the testid attribute is ever renamed.
